mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 units, indicating increased consumer spending, boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1500 units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs decrease.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 in a month, the combined signal predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to a strong labor market.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.1) in triggered instances compared to non-triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a quarter, indicating a supply chain rebound, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate improved corporate productivity.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between INDPRO and SPX returns remains below 0.1 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annual growth rate (GDPC1) below 2%, signaling reduced consumer spending, predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, the combined signal predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to tightening monetary policy and inflation concerns.
failure_condition: Rank IC between the signal and SPX returns remains above 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month, signaling labor market weakness, predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the surprise.
failure_condition: Walk-forward mean return in triggered instances is not significantly lower (t-test p > 0.05) than in non-triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months, indicating sustained consumer spending, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate continued economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.1) in triggered instances compared to non-triggered periods.
